articles.title: Trump claims he ended eight wars, so why is Putin-Zelensky hatred still beating his peace plan?
articles.description: U.S. President Donald Trump says progress is being made in efforts to resolve the Russia-Ukraine war, describing the conflict as one of the most difficult diplomatic challenges he has faced. Trump discussed ongoing peace efforts, the heavy casualties suffered by both sides, and the continued need for military preparedness. Addressing questions about ammunition supplies, he said the United States has significant stockpiles while rebuilding and expanding defense production. Trump also spoke about Ukraine’s requests for advanced weapons systems, including long-range missiles and air defense capabilities, as negotiations and military support discussions continue amid the ongoing conflict.

articles.title: Quote of the day by Michel Foucault: 'Maybe the target nowadays is not to discover what we are but to refuse what we are' and how every self-help guru got it wrong
articles.description: Michel Foucault posited that identity is sculpted by societal labels rather than an inherent human essence. He asserted that true freedom lies in critically examining and discarding these imposed identities. Today, power operates subtly through institutions dictating people's identities. Furthermore, technology and algorithms play a role in shaping digital personas, echoing Foucault's warnings. Choosing to resist these labels empowers individuals to transcend predefined identities.
